as_told.title: The rebellion in Atlantis recounted by Plato

plain: The people of Atlantis, the lost island civilisation, committed a great sin by ceasing to sacrifice to and worship the gods, so Zeus called the Olympian gods together and chose to wipe the world clean in what we know as Noah's flood. That is how the philosopher Jason Jorjani retells it, citing the ancient Greek philosopher Plato and his dialogues the Timaeus and Critias. In a second pass he speaks only of "some rebellion in Atlantis" without mentioning the flood, and he offers it as a clue that ancient gods may have been real powers ruling over humanity.
